decisions.statement: A body asks for fast mode by a speed field reading fast.
A beta header asks for fast mode by a token starting fast-mode-.
A request asking in the body or in the beta header is a fast-mode request.
Stripping the body drops the speed field.
Stripping the body keeps the fields beside speed.
A body carrying no speed field strips to nothing.
A body that is no JSON object strips to nothing.
Stripping a beta header drops the tokens starting fast-mode-.
Stripping a beta header keeps the tokens not starting fast-mode-.
A beta header left with no token is deleted rather than sent empty.
A strip that changes neither the body nor the beta header returns nothing.
A strip leaves the headers handed in unchanged.
A caller reads the beta header under the name anthropic-beta.
A request asking fast mode by header alone loses a speed field reading slow.
Nothing here chooses which model serves a fast-mode request.

definition: a request stripped of what asks for fast mode
